name: Sidisi
description: Sidisi is an undead naga and the khan of the Sultai, a ruthless ruler who also serves the dragon Silumgar as his translator and vizier while secretly plotting against him.

summary.text: Sidisi is an undead naga and the khan of the Sultai, a ruthless ruler who also serves the dragon Silumgar as his translator and vizier while secretly plotting against him.

bio.text: As khan of the Sultai, Sidisi sent her chief advisor and enforcer Taigam to carry out her decrees.

citations.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.
"Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

bio.text: She took the crown from the severed head of the previous khan and purged her rivals, but later sat crownless, obsessed with revenge on a goblin who had taken it.

citations.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.
"Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

bio.text: She raised an army by levying each province and demanding the eldest born, with Rakshasa emissaries enforcing the levy.

citations.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.
"Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

bio.text: When a youth among the recruits attacked her with a poisoned dagger, she killed him, then stabbed Jhinu with the dagger and resolved never again to show mercy, planning to destroy the Mardu and humiliate Zurgo.

citations.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.
"Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.
"Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

bio.text: As an undead naga who had lost the ability to feel pleasure, she served as Silumgar's translator and appeared loyal, but secretly kept poisons in the hole where her heart was, waiting for the day to take back power and make the naga rulers.

citations.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.
"The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

bio.text: When an envoy tried to kill Silumgar with poison and failed, she threw him into the sibsig pit to be devoured.

citations.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.
"The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

bio.text: In a later story, a rakshasa took her form to carry out her plan, and Nishang swore to serve her vengeance, offering a piece of his soul to seal the pact.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Sultai: Betrayal" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Mar 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Sidisi is Silumgar's undead naga vizier, and Nishang has sworn to serve her vengeance plot.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Sultai: Betrayal" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: An envoy speaks and Sidisi replies.
timeline.quote: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

citation.text: Set Adrift (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi, who sends him to enforce her decrees, watched by Ebirri.
timeline.quote: Taigam rose to chief advisor of Sidisi, the kahn of the Sultai.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi sits crownless, obsessed with revenge on a goblin who took her crown, having fed her warning advisors to the Mother Crocodile.
timeline.quote: One by one, her most trusted advisors had warned her against the course of blind revenge

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Sidisi took the crown from the severed head of the previous khan and purged her rivals.
timeline.quote: The crown had once been taken by Sidisi herself, off of the freshly severed head of the previous khan.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Jhinu is revealed to have framed three dead goblins for stealing her crown to win tax duties, and Sidisi has kept him alive as a living reminder of fates worse than death.
timeline.quote: She kept him alive as a reminder to all that there were fates worse than death.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi mocks Jhinu that no relative is left to barter for his life and threatens to give him to the pits.
timeline.quote: If nobody is left who would barter for your life, maybe you are worthless.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi explains she has raised an army by levying five percent of each province, then demanding the eldest born, with Rakshasa enforcing compliance.
timeline.quote: she had requested that all of the Sultai provinces provide five percent of their population to be enlisted into Sidisi's army.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Jhinu presents recruits from the Niraj province, and Sidisi spots a thirteen-year-old youth among them.
timeline.quote: In the back was a youth, no more than thirteen years old.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The youth attacks Sidisi with a poisoned dagger, but she hurls Jhinu into him and breaks the youth's neck.
timeline.quote: The youth attempted to regain his footing, but found the queen's tail around his neck.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi identifies the poison on Jhinu as Silumgar's Breath, realizing the attack was a personal attempt on her life.
timeline.quote: It was known as Silumgar's Breath

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi kills Jhinu by thrusting the dagger into his chest rather than letting him suffer.
timeline.quote: Sidisi picked up the dagger and thrust it squarely into Jhinu's chest.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sidisi resolves never again to show mercy and plans to raise a vast army to destroy the Mardu and humiliate Zurgo.
timeline.quote: Soon, the great orc Zurgo himself would adorn her palace as her greatest prize.

citation.text: "Mercy" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Silumgar's dragonlord discovers Sidisi's manipulation of translations and has her executed.
timeline.quote: when he discovered her manipulation, the paranoid dragonlord had her executed

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Silumgar has Sidisi raised as an intelligent undead servant.
timeline.quote: so he had her raised as an intelligent undead servant, one he could more closely control

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sidisi rallies the naga and gains the allegiance of many sibsig, though she remains loyal to Silumgar for now.
timeline.quote: Sidisi has been able to rally the naga and gain the allegiance of a large number of sibsig zombies

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed by Oret; Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
timeline.quote: Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Dragons of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sidisi recalls her death by the knife and her revival as an undead naga, which took away her ability to feel pleasure.
timeline.quote: as the knife plunged into her heart, and the necromancers chanted the spell that would bring her back

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: A caravan from Marang arrives with tribute, and a human sent by Jhinu offers Sidisi a purse of jewels for an audience.
timeline.quote: Jhinu sent me," he said, handing Sidisi a small purse of gems.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sidisi confronts the envoy about the short tribute and warns that he must speak to her, not to the dragon.
timeline.quote: Do you not believe that your Lord deserves his cut?

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The envoy reveals three vials of Jrung Orchid poison and asks to approach the dragon to kill him.
timeline.quote: Allow me to approach the dragon, and I can end his reign.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The envoy throws a vial at Silumgar, who is unharmed, and Silumgar's poison breath engulfs the room.
timeline.quote: It sailed across the room and struck Silumgar's massive body.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sidisi drags the dying envoy to the sibsig pit and throws him in to be devoured.
timeline.quote: Sidisi unceremoniously tossed the man's near-lifeless body into the pit.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sidisi reveals she keeps a collection of poisons in the hole where her heart was, waiting for the day to take back power and make the naga rulers.
timeline.quote: On that day, she would take the power the dragon had stolen from her, and the naga would become what they were always meant to be—rulers of these lands.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Nishang awakens as an undead sibsig and meets what appears to be Titsui, who says Sidisi saved them both.
timeline.quote: I was wounded, mortally, but I was saved by the only one who may have loved our master more than us: Sidisi.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Sultai: Betrayal" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Titsui explains the plan: Nishang will attend Dauna's ceremony for the newly undead carrying poisons from Sidisi in his new arm.
timeline.quote: Poisons gathered by Sidisi during her tenure of service to our master

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Sultai: Betrayal" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sidisi appears and Nishang swears to serve, offering a piece of his soul to seal the pact.
timeline.quote: I will give anything and everything to bring back all that we've lost. I swear to serve.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Sultai: Betrayal" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Rebels breach Qarsi Palace and Sidisi realizes her rule is ending.
timeline.quote: As the rebels breached Qarsi Palace, she realized her time in power was at its end.

citation.text: Sidisi, Regent of the Mire (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sidisi scolds the sibsig Nishang.
timeline.quote: "Who are you to defy me? In my time, the sibsig knew their place."

citation.text: Cruel Truths (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi and executes her decrees.
timeline.quote: Taigam rose to the chief advisor of Sidisi

citation.text: "Ebirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kotis is partly responsible for Sidisi's defeat.
timeline.quote: Kotis was partially responsible for Sidisi 's defeat

citation.text: "Kotis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Sidisi is the Sultai khan, aiming to gather all clans under her banner.
timeline.quote: Sidisi was the Sultai khan

citation.text: "Sidisi", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Sidisi is reduced to Silumgar's undead slave and vizier, secretly fermenting poison to kill him.
timeline.quote: Sidisi never became Khan and was reduced to one of

citation.text: "Sidisi", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion Silumgar's kingdom falls and Sidisi, wounded in a raid on Qarsi Palace, retreats to the northern swamps.
timeline.quote: Silumgar's kingdom fell to the resurgent clans and Sidisi lost all of her political influence

citation.text: "Sidisi", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A rakshasa servant tricks Nishang, planting Sidisi's poison in his prosthetic; it destroys hundreds of sibsig at a ceremony.
timeline.quote: the poison spread through the ceremonial pool and destroyed hundreds of other sibsig

citation.text: "Sidisi", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: We have a word for enemies too mutilated for military service: furniture.

citation.text: Dutiful Return (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
